description: 1966 is the Year of the Fire Horse in the Chinese zodiac, from January 21, 1966 to February 8, 1967. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1966 is the Year of the Fire Horse, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 21, 1966 and ended on February 8, 1967, so people born in 1966 before Jan 21 belong to the Wood Snake year.

sections.heading: When the 1966 Fire Horse year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1966 Fire Horse year began at Lunar New Year on January 21, 1966 and lasted until February 8, 1967, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Jan 21 1966 therefore belongs to the Wood Snake year that started in 1965, while someone born in early 1967, up to Feb 8, is still a Fire Horse. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Fire Horse combination also falls in 2026, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1966 fell on a Friday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Fire Horse personality
paragraphs: Spirited, independent and passionate, the Fire Horse is famous in folklore for its strength of will. The Horse's fixed element is Fire, so this year doubles it, and tradition describes tremendous energy and courage. People born now love adventure and speak their minds. Burnout is the classic risk, which steady routines around rest and food help prevent. Life with them is seldom quiet, but it is rarely dull.

Fire is the element of summer and full daylight, and a Fire year is traditionally said to turn up the volume of whatever animal it meets. Descriptions link it with passion, charisma, courage and a love of movement and expression. Fire-year people are often portrayed as lively, persuasive and quick to act, able to warm a room and rally others behind an idea. The element is associated with the heart and with joy, which gives it real generosity of spirit. Its traditional shadow is impatience: Fire can burn hot and fast, leading to restlessness, sharp words in the moment and a tendency to lose interest once the excitement fades.

sections.heading: 1966 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits add up to 22, the master builder's number, kept whole and associated with large, practical plans. The digits of 1966 add up to 22. In the twelve-year cycle the Horse is the seventh animal, earthly branch Wu, with Fire as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Fire, and in the five-element cycles fire year element matches the fixed element. The year before was the Wood Snake and the year after is the Fire Goat.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Bing-Wu: Bing is the Fire heavenly stem and Wu is the Horse's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1966?
faq.answer: 1966 is the Year of the Fire Horse. It started on January 21, 1966 and ended on February 8, 1967.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1966?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 21. Born before January 21, 1966, you are a Wood Snake; born on or after it, you are a Fire Horse.

faq.question: What element is 1966 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Fire, a Yang year. The Horse's own fixed element is Fire; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1966?
faq.answer: Bing-Wu. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Fire Horse year?
faq.answer: 2026, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2026.
